Name: Red Hair Haley
Author: holychurros
Description:
I felt like Haley could use a little more pop of color! I made this one for myself awhile back, and I finally finished a solid Ginger Island addition!

I hope to use this for a Haley rewrite soon. Let me know if there are any issues visually.

Compatibility:

This is just a Haley visual replacement. There should be compatibility with any SVE or any other neighborhood extenders. If you're looking for a seasonal addition, I'm not as great yet with that. I hope to be able to add that in the future!

[b]How to use[/b]:

This is just a classic Content Patcher. Download, unzip, and drop it in your Mods folder with Content Patcher! As long as there aren't any other visual Haley mods, you should be good to go!

If someone wants to use this as a base for a seasonal, message me!

Downloads.Description: An edit of classic Haley. Visual only and for Content Patcher. She sports a new yellow dress and a heart necklace. (Updated Sprite)

Manifest.Name: Haley Refresh
Manifest.Description: A refresh of Vanilla Haley, Red hair, yellow sundress, seafood green eyes, and a periwinkle bathing suit.
